Marginal notes on the left are small and partly illegible; they were not reliably readable and are omitted. The woodcut initial "N" is taken as the first letter of "ON abs". Several words in the body are doubtful and should be checked against the original: "praefixi", "neceffitas", "inutilem", "dubitarent", "impru-dentis", "bruto", "tinus" (likely "vitae" with show-through), and "Iamnode" (likely "Iam nunc" or similar). Lines near the right edge of the body and the bottom "lych-" are cut off by the scan. These readings are provisional; the transcription above contains words I could not verify letter by letter and they should be treated as unreliable.
